content: Subscription (OAuth) auth works with claude -p: empirical stream-json system/init event reported apiKeySource: none with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, and the run completed successfully. Therefore do NOT use --bare (docs: skips OAuth and keychain reads; Anthropic auth must be ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or apiKeyHelper) and do NOT add any Rust Anthropic API SDK crate — the driver must shell out to the claude binary to inherit the user's subscription credentials. A rate_limit_event message type is emitted in stream-json carrying status/resetsAt/rateLimitType (e.g. five_hour) — the driver should consume it for backoff. system/api_retry events carry error categories including rate_limit, overloaded, authentication_failed.
